svg.title: No.1 (BYD Open Remote) — Live Widget Preview, Custom Combos & 4-Slot Customizer (Figma / Penpot Editable Vector)
svg.text: No.1 · Live Widget Preview + Custom Action Combos + 4 Changeable Widget Slots
Layered Figma / Penpot vector artboards — every screen frame & slot component is grouped for editing.

g.text: # Frame 1 · Preferences → Live 4×3 Widget Preview & 4 Slot Configurator
Live Preview (Tap a button to edit slot)
Unlock → AC Lvl 2 · Fan 5 · Face+Feet → Lights
# Frame 2 · Bottom Sheet → Assign Widget Button Slot
Unlock → Start AC (Lvl 2, Fan 5) → Flash Lights
2×2 Grid also binds exact Slots 1–4 in a 2×2 tile layout
